item.tib: gso rig 'bum rgyud kun kyi gces btus 'chi bdag zhags bcod bde ba'i dbugs 'byin
item.coloph: ces gso rig rgyud 'bum bye ba'i yang snying sbyar thabs stong rtsa las snying po gces btus ji ltar sbyar ba'i tshul yang / spyir g.yu thog pa'i gces btus/ (mchan zla 'od 'bar) gshen mkhas grub/ (shI la d+hA dza) byang pa lhun sdings/ (mchan rnam rgyal grags bzang mi yi nyi ma) zur mkhar pa/ (mchan blo gros rgyal po/ ng+hu ma swA mi) mi dbang sa ra/ (sangs rgyas rgya mtsho) 'bri gung pa/ (kun mchog 'gro yan) del dmar dge bshes/ (bstan 'dzin phun tshogs) kong sprul/ (yon tan rgya mtsho/ phyis su mkhas dbang sogs kyis gces btus rigs mang yang la la bsdus ches nad bcos tha dag ma tshang ba dang / 'ga' zhig thang phye tsam las mtha' dpyad sogs ming tsam gsal min dang / re 'gas sman gyi bzo tshul gtong tshul sogs bral ba'i 'thor bu'i sman sbyor re zung la blo rten 'cha' ba dang / phal cher rnam dag rgyud khungs mthong rgyun med pa las 'ol tshod rdo rje sked bzung lta bur byed mkhan mang du mthong bas/ de phyir rgyas bsdus 'tshams par thang phye nas dpyad mtha'i bar du ma tshang ba med par rgyud khungs bkral te de la myong grub man ngag du mas kha brgyan cing mkhas dman kun gyi phyag len stabs bde'i ched du brgya pa'i rnam 'dren gzugs sku'i bkod pa ngoms nas 'byung ldan sum brgya'i nang tshan lcags pho stag gi lor/ zhang zhung khyung chen spungs rir 'tsho byed 'jigs med nam mkhas bsdebs pa 'dis kyang 'gro khams nyon mongs nad nyes las grol te sangs rgyas sman bla'i go 'phang mchog chen la mnga' brnyes pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
